name: chip_fab
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a replacement inventory pixel-art sprite for an AUTOMATED ELECTRONIC MODULE FABRICATOR, a self-contained industrial MACHINE. First two attached images are original game style references. Third image is the rejected previous design: preserve its muted grey-green/dusty violet/cream palette ONLY; completely replace its open workbench silhouette. Main shape is a squat almost-square enclosed metal industrial cabinet with rounded bevelled upper corners, thick roof, continuous side walls and closed motor/service housing at its base. Upper front has one small smoked-glass processing chamber window; inside it only a simplified small vertical assembly spindle and green circuit board are visible. A prominent horizontal module output slot below this window, a narrow vertical input hopper on one side, and a small integrated control panel on the other. Prioritize large readable planes and compact industrial mass. No open desktop, exposed articulated arm, gantry, spool sitting on a desk, tool drawers, table legs, furniture, or workshop scene. Slight top surface visible, otherwise straight-on view. Native logical size 48x48 pixels: use coarse crisp pixels, simple broad shapes, 14-20 muted colors, dark one-logical-pixel outline, restrained cream highlights, no fine texture or dither or gradients. Machine fills a roughly 44x44 square; all nine centres of its 3x3 inventory grid fall on opaque cabinet body. Single centered object, genuine transparent exterior, no text, no labels, no floor, no cast shadow. Keep the original game compact utilitarian style rather than a detailed miniature scene.
